column4: Close the original operator scripts/code audit coverage gap: classify the duplicate/dead-code candidates from the existing map with caller and installed-copy evidence, assess risks and priorities, and create bounded owner-linked tasks or explicit dispositions for each unresolved finding. Do not move or delete files.

Verify the TG intake acceptance contract in an isolated test: a synthetic ask carries its immutable ask key into a chain, dispatches exactly one owner, and cannot close without an artifact. Avoid injecting a synthetic ask into live operator intake; publish test evidence and any required implementation task.
